status: research only; nothing ships; no other repo file changed
headline: D (one statewide >=20 dBZ product per 2-min step; desktop derives 35/50 dBZ and crops to places) is the lowest-blocker server option: 0.732 MB per active frame, 2.28 GB per month per machine at 8.5 storm days, 4.0 MB/month ingest cost not counted; host floor $6.49/mo (unpriced RAM).
A (each crew machine downloads NOAA GRIB2 and decodes) needs 70.5 GB per machine per month at 33 levels and has no Windows eccodes wheel on pip.
B (GitHub Actions, 5-min floor) cannot publish every 2-min step and its Actions terms clause for data delivery is an open owner/legal reading.
Frame budget (README sec 10, proposed here): 1.0 MB per 2-min MRMS frame; 60 MB per 2-h loop at >=20 dBZ; 0.05 MB per GOES 5-min frame.

inputs.units: B = bytes (1 MB = 1e6 B). gz = gzipped NOAA object. zlib9 = Python stdlib zlib level 9. est = estimate from a named ratio. Month = 30 days. Storm day = 12 h. 2-min MRMS step = 30/h; 5-min GOES step = 12/h.

corrections_to_evidence: mrms.json installed_packages omits eckitlib: eccodeslib 2.50.0.33 requires eckitlib==2.5.0.33 (35.98 MB wheel). The eccodes Linux closure is 62.16 MB of wheels, not about 10 MB.
eccodes has no Windows path on pip: eccodes metadata has 'Requires-Dist: eccodeslib; platform_system != "Windows"', and pip finds no eccodeslib wheel for win_amd64 at cp311, cp312 or cp313.
eccodeslib 2.50.0.33 has no macOS arm64 wheel for cp312 (newest 2.48.0.26). netCDF4 1.7.5 has no macOS arm64 wheel for cp312 (newest 1.7.4). Version skew across platforms.
cffi resolves to 2.0.0b1 (a beta) in the Linux closure; mrms.json lists cffi 2.1.1. Needs a deliberate pin.

Storing dBZ at 0.5 dB moves threshold counts in the 33-level event frame: >=35 gives 99,867 not 99,854; >=50 gives 13,484 not 13,482. Raw MRMS values are on a 0.1 dBZ grid (mrms.json fact 26), so the product stores 0.1 dBZ.
D12 has no MRMS or GOES keys (app-integration fact 6; README sec 3 cites D12 for them). The MRMS 10 min and GOES 15 min limits used here are proposals needing a DECISIONS entry.
hosting-options.json: S3 Standard storage ($0.023/GB-mo) and PUT ($0.005 per 1k) were not on the AWS pricing page read today. The GET price and the 100 GB free transfer were confirmed.
Storm-day rate: the supervisor log reports 26 of 92 summer-2025 days with Montana hail rows (W20). Not re-derived here; used only as an assumption.

format_proposal.choice: binary payload + JSON sidecar (not compact JSON)
format_proposal.payload: zlib9; little-endian; header MRV1, n_groups u32, n_voxels u32; per row group: key u16 (level*615+row), count u16, column deltas u16 (absolute at row start), tenth-dBZ u16 (>=200 for 20 dBZ); mask section: keyframe uint8 class per cell (0 = -999, 1 = -99, 2 = valid) or changed-cell list (u32 index delta + u8 class)
format_proposal.rejected: dense grid: 3.0x larger; 2-bit packed mask: larger than byte mask (252,681 vs 238,142); 0.5 dB storage: smaller by 14% but threshold counts drift
format_proposal.sidecar: JSON, estimated 3-5 kB (not measured; the prototype's 33-level metadata block is 9.6 kB because it repeats per-level codes): schema_version, grid (origin 49.745 N, -116.795 E, 0.01 deg, 1350 x 615, row 0 north), levels_km, valid_time_utc per level, retrieved_utc, last_run_utc, next_expected_utc, objects with gz bytes and sha256, codes meaning (-999 and -99 = no radar data, meanings unverified), counts per level, keyframe flag, stored thresholds, freshness max_age_min (proposal), demo false
format_proposal.naming: product times in UTC; file name carries the joined step time; sidecar carries source object stamps

ranking_by_open_blockers_today.note: fewest open blockers first; a ranking of blockers, not of merit; all four stay open until D-G2 is decided
ranking_by_open_blockers_today.1_D: blockers: host decision (needed by ROADMAP 8 and 11 anyway); RAM plan unpriced; product spec and stdlib parser to build. Reasons: 0.732 MB per active frame, 2.28 GB per machine-month at 8.5 storm days, desktop decode 0.18 s per frame, no GRIB or netCDF in the installer.
ranking_by_open_blockers_today.2_C: same host and cadence as D; 1.56 times D's active bytes because three files repeat the same mask; same blockers.
ranking_by_open_blockers_today.3_B: blockers: GitHub Actions terms clause for data delivery (owner or legal reading); 5-min floor against 2-min steps; D12 10-min limit at risk from queue delay; silent drops need an external staleness check; private-repo minutes 33.84-39.84/mo if the repo goes private. Reasons: no server; $0 at these volumes if the terms reading allows it.
ranking_by_open_blockers_today.4_A: blockers: no Windows eccodes wheel (native-library sourcing decision); +62.16 MB Linux wheels; 15% of one core per 2-min frame; 70.5 GB per machine-month at 33 levels; needs 1.54 Mbit/s sustained. Reasons: no server; NOAA reads are open data with attribution required (registry quote, evidence).
ranking_by_open_blockers_today.what_would_change_it: A: a Windows native GRIB2 source plus a crew link of at least 2 Mbit/s; B: an owner or legal reading that permits data delivery plus acceptance of 5-min products; C and D: a host choice with 1 GB RAM
